Feb. 18th. 37.
1.

Labour Dispute, at the S.M.C. P.W.D. Depot, Shunteh Rd.

At 6.45a.m. 18-2-37, a telephone message was received from P.W.D. Inspector Holt, attached to the Shunteh Road Depot requesting the services of a Police Officer. S/I. Duncan attended, and ascertained from Mr. Holt, that word had been received from a P.W.D. coolie attached to the Sawgin Road Depot, of impending trouble between the P.W.D. Highways and Sewerage coolies. No trouble however, had so far taken place, and at Mr. Holt's request no Police were posted at the Depot.

At approximately 1Pnoon Mr. Holt attended this Station, and reported that a number of coolies had entered his Depot office, and requested Police assistance to have these coolies arrested and detained. Inspt. Crawford, and the undersigned with C.D.S. 18 immediately attended, and found Police already in attendance, on arrival.

The undermentioned coolie representatives of various P.W.D. Depot Highways coolies, were also present in Mr. Holt's office.

1. Lee Ching Chuen (李景春), aged 36, Kompo, Highway coolie, residing at a straw hut, Hung Tsung, O.O.L.
2. Wong Gwang Tsai (王光才), aged 25, Nanking, Highway coolie, residing No. 407 Yulin Road.
(Both Representing the P.W.D. Sawgin Road Depot)
3. Liu Wu Wen (刘武文), aged 43, Kompo, Highway coolie, residing 17 Wei Tung Li, Ping An Road, O.O.L. representing the Antung Road P.W.D. Depot.
4. Shee Chiu Loong (施九龍), aged 43, Kompo, Highway coolie, residing straw hut, Chei Mei Road, O.O.L. representing the Tong An Road P.W.D. Depot.

1937年2月18日。
1.

工部局工务处堆栈（顺泰路）劳资纠纷。

1937年2月18日上午6时45分，接到附属于顺泰路堆栈的工务处督察霍尔特（Holt）的电话留言，请求派遣一名警官。副督察邓肯（Duncan）前往，并从霍尔特先生处获悉，收到一名隶属于曹家渡路堆栈的工务处苦力的消息，称工务处道路与下水道苦力之间即将发生骚乱。然而，截至目前尚未发生任何骚乱，应霍尔特先生的要求，未在堆栈部署警力。

约下午1时，霍尔特先生来到本警署，报告称有一群苦力进入其堆栈办公室，并请求警方协助逮捕并拘留这些苦力。克劳福德（Crawford）督察、下文署名者以及第18号中国侦探社警员立即前往，到达时发现已有警察在场。

下列来自各工务处堆栈的道路苦力代表也出现在霍尔特的办公室内。

1. 李景春，36岁，广东人，道路苦力，居住于外越界筑路区虹宗的一处草棚。
2. 王光才，25岁，南京人，道路苦力，居住于榆林路407号。
（两人均代表工务局曹家渡路堆栈）
3. 刘武文，43岁，广东人，道路苦力，居住于外越界筑路区平安路维德里17号，代表安通路工务处堆栈。
4. 施九龍，43岁，广东人，道路苦力，居住于外越界筑路区齐眉路的一处草棚，代表同安路工务处堆栈。

Subject P.W.D.Strike situation Gordon Road Police District.

Made by D.S.I.Read. Forwarded by [Signature]

Sir,
Enquiries have been made since the commencement
of the present unrest, at the Markham & Gordon Road P.W.D.
Depots by C.D.C.202. These depots are not concerned with road
construction and at present are not involved nor according
to enquiries, is any trouble anticipated.
Road gangs are at work at two points in this
district.
1. About 60 workers employed on Haiphong Road.
2. About 10 workers employed on Yenping Road.
Enquiries made by C.D.C.293 at noon and again at
4.30 p.m. 1/2/37, reveals that the full complement are working
with the exception of 6 men who left work on Haiphong Road
following the visit of another person at about 8.30 a.m.
1/2/37. Indications are that the remaining coolies will con-
tinue to work as long as they are not subject to intimidation.

REPORT No. 2.
Date 8th March 19 37.

Subject Meeting of P.W.D. Road Coolies.

Made by D.S.I. Shields Forwarded by Insp. E.D. Evans

Sir,

At 7 p.m. on the 8-3-37, it was learned that the meeting,
as mentioned in Misc. 83/3 was about to take place at No. 8/351
Elgin Road. C.D.S. 22 was therefore detailed to attend and on
his return at 7.50 p.m., it was learned that a meeting took place,
between 7.20 p.m. and 7.40 p.m. and took the form of a lecture
presided over by one named Zung Cheu Foong (陳九峰) who pointed
out the stupidity of causing trouble over small affairs, stating
that if the coolies did their work properly and anything of
importance arose in the future Mr. Yu Ya Ching could be relied
upon to take the matter up on their behalf.

The meeting was attended by 34 coolies who afterwards left
in an orderly manner.

I am, Sir,
Your obedient servant,
J. J. Shields
D. S. I.

D.D.O. "C" Div.

Officer i/c,
Special Branch.

Subject Arrest of P.W.D. Road coolies,

Made by D.S.I. Shields, Forwarded by Inspt E.D. Roo

Sir,
At 8 a.m. on the 8-3-37, S.P.C. 662 brought to the
Station a male Chinese named Wong Zung Zai (王双才), M/
P.W.D. coolie, No. 296, native of Nanking residing 407
Jansen Road, whom he had arrested on Haining Road near the
station gate whilst conversing with other P.W.D. coolies, it
being thought by the S.P.C. that the accused was trying to
incite the other coolies to strike, he having heard the words
Boo Koong (罢工) used by the accused.
Enquiries were made by C.N.S. 69 and the undersigned,
who on questioning the accused learned that approximately
one week previously the accused together with two other
coolies handed their badges to Mr. Yu Ya Ching as samples,
the coolies having made a request to that gentleman that the
badges of sewerage coolies be distinct from those of Road
coolies, since that time up to Saturday morning 6-3-37 the
coolies had been refused work owing to them having no badge.
At 3 p.m. on the 6-3-37 the accused recovered his badge from
Mr. Yu Ya Ching and reported for work at the Dixwell Road
Depot at 6.30 a.m. this inst but did not fall in with the
other coolies as he wanted to report back for duty personally
to the Foreign Inspector (Mr. Weidman). As he had not fallen
in with the remainder Mr. Weidman refused to give him employ-
ment, but later recanted and said that the accused could start
work at 9 a.m. but would lose a quarter of a days pay, the
accused not being satisfied with Mr. Weidman offer, borrowed
a bicycle and proceeded to his Union Headquarters at No.
8/351 Elgin Road where he was advised to return to his work
and the matter would be taken up with the P.W.D. commissioner

阁下，
1937年3月8日上午8时，第662号上海警察警员将一名名为王双才（Wong Zung Zai）的中国男子带至警署，该人为工务处苦力，编号296，南京籍，居住于詹森路407号。该警员在警署大门附近的海宁路上将其逮捕，当时他正与其他工务处苦力交谈。该警员认为被告试图煽动其他苦力罢工，因为他听到被告使用了“Boo Koong”（罢工）一词。
第69号中国侦探社警员和下文署名者进行了调查，在讯问被告后得知，大约一周前，被告连同另外两名苦力将他们的徽章交给虞洽卿先生作为样本，这些苦力曾请求这位先生将下水道苦力的徽章与道路苦力的徽章区分开来；自那时起直至1937年3月6日（星期六）上午，由于没有徽章，这些苦力一直被拒绝提供工作。
1937年3月6日下午3时，被告从虞洽卿先生处取回徽章，并于本月6日上午6时30分到狄思威路堆栈报到上班，但他未与其他苦力列队，因为他想亲自向外籍督察（魏德曼先生）报到复工。由于他未与其他人列队，魏德曼先生拒绝雇用他，但后来改变主意，说被告可以在上午9时开始工作，但会扣除四分之一天的工资。被告对魏德曼先生的提议不满意，借了一辆自行车，前往其位于爱尔近路8/351号的工会总部，在那里他被告知回去工作，此事将与工务处专员

8th March 1937.

West Hongkew Police Station.

Sir,

We beg to inform you that a letter has been received from
the S.M.C. Road Construction Coolies Mutual Aid Association,
stating that a foreigner named Weidman of the Dixwell Road
Depot was oppressive to the road coolies, which caused all the
coolies to get angry and commenced a go-slow strike.

A representative was detailed by the above mentioned
Association to persuade the coolies to resume work pending a
settlement. After being persuaded, all the coolies resumed
work, but 3 road coolies named Wong Saung Zai et al who were
sent from the above Association, were arrested by West Hongkew
Police Station. By doing so all the road coolies became
afraid.

As the Road Construction coolies Mutual Aid Association
wish to avoid an extended strike, we are hereby requested by
them to ask you for the release of the arrested coolies in order
to appease the road coolies.

As the coolies are living in a poor condition, please
release them immediately.

Special District Citizens'

At 10.20a.m. 2/2/37 F.P.S. 57 Snuggs brought to
Bubbling Well Station a former P.W.D. casual labourer named
Liang Kyi Koh (梁棋高) Taichow, age 34, living in Chapei,

on the site mentioned, stated that he could not identify Liang

is attached.

wish to press a charge against the accused. On the instructions
of Mr. R.W. Yorke D.O."B" Liang Kyi Koh was later released.

首次报案记录 161/37 静安寺。
1937年2月2日。

1937年2月2日上午10时20分，静安寺警局57号警员斯纳格斯（Snuggs）将一名前工务局临时劳工梁棋高（Liang Kyi Koh），泰州人，34岁，住闸北，带至静安寺警局。该员于当日上午10时05分在大西路近提篮桥路附近将其逮捕。当时，梁棋高是七、八名苦力中的一员，他们命令一些工务局筑路工人停止工作。

在现场受雇的工务局第153号领班王阿连（Wong Ah Li）表示，他无法指认梁棋高是命令其手下苦力停工的人群中的一员。他否认曾使用任何威胁手段恐吓工人。

在梁棋高的口袋中发现一份工部局筑路工人互助会的宣言。译文附后。

经询问，工部局/工务局表示不愿对被告提出指控。根据“B”分区代理总监约克（R.W. Yorke）先生的指示，梁棋高随后被释放。

MANIFEST FROM THE S.M.C. ROADWORK COOLIES MUTUAL AID ASSOCIATION.

We, the roadwork coolies, having been working for the
S.M.C. for tens of years hard labour in making roads day and night,
which brings the present prosperity in Shanghai, are now curtailed
altogether. As the Council is persistent in its desire, we are
compelled to form a strong organisation to decidedly oppose the
Council's unreasonable suppression, and to solicit for public
support.

According to the Council's excuse, it is a retrenchment
measure, but in fact the wages paid to the thousands of coolies
are far less than the wages paid to ten of the high ranked foreign
officials. If it actually was for the sake of retrenchment, the
wages of the high foreign officials should be reduced, and it
would not be necessary to trouble the lowly paid Chinese coolies,
rendering them jobless to increase the uneasiness of the public.
This is the first point.

Secondly, speaking for the roadwork, the highways are
being gradually extended and widened. The traffic is increasing
and they are more busy. Roadwork is more busy, which necessitates
in engaging more road coolies.

Thirdly, the labourers in various trades are demanding an
increase in wages, but we the road coolies are conservatives,
keeping on work as usual without fault. Now we are made to suffer
the pains of unemployment.

Fourthly, it may be recalled that during the Sino-Japanese
trouble in Shanghai, all the defence work of the Settlement was
completed by us regardless of the shellfire above our heads. This
can be proved by the number of dead and injured. No pity was ever
given to these loyal and meritorious works.

In other words, the Council is curtailing the road coolies
unreasonably and despising the Chinese. We were recruited to
work. Now we are kicked out from our jobs.

We, road coolies, will never drop our humanity or disgrace
our national integrity. We will fight for a just settlement and
fair treatment.

工部局筑路苦力互助会宣言。

我等筑路苦力，为工部局辛勤劳作数十载，日夜修筑道路，造就了今日上海之繁荣，如今却遭全面裁减。鉴于公局坚持其意愿，我等被迫组成强有力的组织，坚决反对公局不合理的压制，并寻求公众支持。

公局借口此为紧缩措施，但实际上支付给数千名苦力的工资远低于支付给十名高级外籍官员的工资。若确为紧缩起见，理应削减高级外籍官员的工资，而无须麻烦薪水微薄之华籍苦力，使其失业，从而增加公众的不安。此乃第一点。

其次，就筑路而言，公路正在逐步延伸和拓宽。交通量日益增加，工作更为繁忙。筑路工作更加繁忙，这就需要雇佣更多的筑路苦力。

第三，各行业劳工均要求增加工资，而我等筑路苦力持保守态度，照常工作，毫无过失。如今却让我们遭受失业之苦。

第四，回想上海中日冲突期间，租界的所有防御工事均由我等不顾头顶炮火完成。死伤人数即可证明这一点。对于这些忠诚且有功绩的劳工，从未给予丝毫怜悯。

换言之，公局无理裁减筑路苦力，蔑视华人。我等被招募工作，如今却被踢出工作岗位。

我等筑路苦力，绝不丧失人性或辱没民族气节。我们将为公正的解决和公平的待遇而战。

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
Misc. File No....18/37. 7758/2
Yangtzepoo Station, - 3/2.
REPORT
Date February 2., 1937.

Subject Re strike of P.W.D. Road Construction Coolies.

Made by D.S.I. Willgoss Forwarded by [Signature] Inspt. O. i/c

Sir,
During the forenoon of the 2/2/37 8 P.W.D. foremen were
taken to Tingliang Road west of Linching Road with a view to
making safe and usable a section of the road which was under
repair when the coolie strike commenced.
Due to the recent heavy rain, the heavy vehicular traffic
has turned the road into a quagmire which had made the road
almost unusable.
About 11 a.m. a striking coolie rode past on a bicycle and
shouted to foreman No. 133, Zung Kvi Ho, that if he did not
cease work he would be shot. Shortly afterwards another coolie
rode past and repeated the threat.
Almost immediately after the second threat the 3 foremen
ceased work and returned to Antung Road Depot. En route they
met Inspector Wellstead of the P.W.D. and informed him of what
had occurred.

I am, Sir,
Yours obediently,
[Signature]
D. S. I.

D.D.O. "D"
Copy forwarded to O. i/c S.B.

上海公共租界工部局警务处。
杂项档案号....18/37. 7758/2
杨树浦警局，- 2月3日。
报告
日期：1937年2月2日。

事由：关于工务局筑路苦力罢工事宜。

呈报人：副巡官威尔戈斯（Willgoss） 转呈人：[签名] 主管督察

先生：
1937年2月2日上午，8名工务局领班被带至林清路西面的定良路，目的是使一段在苦力罢工开始时正在维修的道路变得安全且可用。
由于近期大雨，沉重的车辆交通已将道路变成泥沼，致使道路几乎无法使用。
上午11时许，一名罢工苦力骑自行车经过，并向133号领班钟桂和（Zung Kvi Ho）喊叫，称若不停止工作将被枪击。不久后，另一名苦力骑车经过并重复了这一威胁。
在第二次威胁发生后几乎立即，这3名领班停止工作并返回安东路堆栈。途中他们遇到了工务局的威尔斯特德（Wellstead）督察，并向他通报了所发生的情况。

此致，
您顺从的，
[签名]
副巡官。

“D”分区副总监。
副本已转送特别课主管警官。
